name: twenty-twenty
description: 20% of the stake is offline from the start, then a short 50/50 partition. Alpenglow's fast path needs 80% Notarize votes, so finality normally falls back to the 60% + 60% slow path; during the partition neither side holds 60% of the stake and the chain stalls safely until the heal. This is the offline arm of the 20+20 resilience model.
